title: Require Name
statement: Implement `solve(pairs, key)`. Same pairs as a name lookup. Return the name when the key exists. When it does not, return the string `missing`. This is the required-name path: absence is not a successful empty result.
constraints: A present empty name is returned
hints: Do not treat an empty name as missing.
Return missing only when the key never appears.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The caller that requires a name has already decided absence is a bug.

editorial: The caller that requires a name has already decided absence is a bug. Returning a distinct missing marker is the sandbox form of raising KeyError. Collapsing absence and an empty name hides a stored blank.
